title: 6sense vs Demandbase: an honest 2027 comparison
summary: 6sense vs Demandbase on intent, predictive models, ads, data, Vendr pricing and fit, plus when a contact-level command center is the better pick.
body_markdown:
6sense and Demandbase are both enterprise ABM platforms that score accounts on intent, run account-based ads and give sales a view of each account. 6sense leans harder on predictive AI and buying stages, while Demandbase stands out for its native B2B DSP and its advertising depth. Vendr data puts the median contract at about $54,000 a year for 6sense and $65,000 for Demandbase. If your real problem is that reps need to know which person to contact, neither one is built for that, and a contact-level command center may fit better.


### 6sense vs Demandbase at a glance


**Core strength**


- 6sense: predictive account scoring and buying stages
- Demandbase: account-based advertising and account intelligence


**Intent sources**


- 6sense: keyword intent and anonymous web activity resolved to accounts, combined with your first-party data
- Demandbase: bidstream keyword intent from its own DSP, web engagement, and Bombora, G2 and TrustRadius intent through integrations


**Signal level**


- 6sense: account
- Demandbase: account


**Predictive models**


- 6sense: predictive buying stages and fit scores
- Demandbase: predictive account scores and journey stages


**Advertising**


- 6sense: runs display and LinkedIn campaigns from the platform
- Demandbase: native B2B DSP


**Orchestration**


- 6sense: segments, workflows and conversational email
- Demandbase: journeys, plays and sales insights in Demandbase One


**Pricing (Vendr, November 2026)**


- 6sense: median $54,250 a year; range about $11,000 to $131,000
- Demandbase: median $65,301 a year; range about $22,000 to $161,000


**Implementation**


- 6sense: G2 reviewers average 3 months to implement and 12 months to ROI
- Demandbase: plan for a multi-month rollout with marketing ops and Salesforce admin support


**Best for**


- 6sense: enterprise teams that want predictive stages to drive the program
- Demandbase: enterprise teams where ads are central to ABM


### Intent data: where the signals come from


Both platforms track which accounts are researching topics you care about. The sources differ.


Demandbase documents its approach in detail. Core keyword intent comes from bidstream access through its own DSP, which reaches more than a million publishers. It adds website engagement and lets you bring in third-party intent from Bombora, G2 and TrustRadius as “Intent Surge.” Intent strength is based on how many people at similar-sized accounts read about a keyword.


6sense resolves large volumes of anonymous web activity to companies and combines it with keyword intent and your first-party data. That intent feeds directly into its predictive model.


Both roll intent up to the account. Neither tells a rep which person at the account did the research.


### Predictive models and scoring


6sense is known for predictive buying stages (target, awareness, consideration, decision, purchase) and account fit scores, and that’s the reason many teams buy it. The trade-off is explainability. Reps see a stage and a score, but the reasoning behind them is harder to trace. We cover this in[the limitations of 6sense in 2026](https://www.usergems.com/blog/limitations-of-6sense-2026) .


Demandbase also offers predictive account scores and journey stages. Teams tend to describe its models as one strong part of a broader suite, where 6sense treats the model as the centerpiece.


### Advertising


Demandbase owns a B2B DSP. You can target, bid and measure account-based display ads without a separate ad tech partner, and that gives it the edge for ad-led ABM.


6sense runs display and LinkedIn campaigns from inside the platform and syncs audiences to other channels. Most teams find it capable for account-based ads, with Demandbase ahead on media control.


### Orchestration and sales workflows


Both platforms push segments and alerts into Salesforce, HubSpot and sales engagement tools. 6sense adds conversational email and sales intelligence modules. Demandbase bundles sales insights and journey-based plays into Demandbase One.


In both cases, someone has to build and maintain the plays. Expect a dedicated ABM or marketing ops owner.


### Data quality


G2 reviews of 6sense often raise data accuracy concerns, especially for contact data. Demandbase reviews more often mention complexity, Salesforce integration work and interface friction. Whichever you’re leaning toward, run a sample test on your own target accounts before you sign.


### Pricing and contracts


Neither vendor publishes list prices. Vendr data shows:


- **6sense:** a median of $54,250 a year across 322 purchases, ranging from about $11,000 to $131,000. Price is driven by the platform fee, accounts monitored, modules and data credits.
- **Demandbase:** a median of $65,301 a year across 164 purchases, ranging from about $22,000 to $161,000. Demandbase explains its model on its pricing page: a platform fee plus a flat fee per user. Advertising and data add-ons push it up.


Both commonly sell annual or multi-year terms, with services billed separately. For what to watch in a 6sense contract, read[6sense cost, pricing transparency and contract lock-in](https://www.usergems.com/blog/6sense-cost-pricing-transparency-and-contract-lock-in) . For the wider category, see[ABM software pricing in 2026](https://www.usergems.com/blog/abm-software-pricing-2026) .


### Questions to ask in both demos


Bring the same list to both vendors. The answers usually make the decision for you.


- **Show me why this account is in the decision stage.** Ask for the specific signals behind the score. If the vendor’s rep can’t explain it, your sellers won’t trust it.
- **Which person at this account should we call?** See how far each platform gets from an account to a named contact.
- **What does year two cost?** Get renewal caps, data overage terms and services fees in writing.
- **Who runs this day to day?** Ask how much headcount their happiest customers dedicate to the platform.
- **How does it reach my SEP and ad accounts?** Check which actions sync automatically and which need someone to export.
- **How long until we see pipeline?** Ask for dated milestones. Our guide to[how long 6sense takes to show ROI](https://www.usergems.com/6sense-limitations/how-long-does-6sense-take-to-show-roi) has the questions to ask.
- **Can I test on my own accounts?** A pilot on 200 of your target accounts beats any slide.


### Who each platform fits


#### Pick 6sense if


- You want predictive buying stages to decide which accounts sales and marketing work.
- You have the ops capacity to tune the model and maintain segments.
- You can wait out a ramp that G2 reviewers put at about 12 months to ROI.


Note that 6sense ended its free Sales Intelligence plan in August 2026, so any trial now runs through a sales-led evaluation.


#### Pick Demandbase if


- Account-based display ads are a large share of your ABM budget.
- You want one contract for ads, intelligence and orchestration.
- You have a Salesforce admin ready to support the integration.


### When neither is the right answer


6sense and Demandbase both answer the question “which accounts are in market?” That helps marketing pick targets. It leaves reps with a list of companies and no names.


If your outbound team keeps asking who to call, why now and what to say, you need signals at the person level. That’s the gap a contact-level command center fills. See our guide to[contact-level vs account-level intent](https://www.usergems.com/6sense-limitations/contact-level-intent-vs-account-level-intent-the-complete-guide) for the full comparison.

### Frequently asked questions


#### Is 6sense or Demandbase better?


Neither wins across the board. 6sense is stronger on predictive buying stages. Demandbase is stronger on native account-based advertising.


#### Which is cheaper, 6sense or Demandbase?


On Vendr, 6sense has the lower median ($54,250 vs $65,301 a year). Your price depends far more on accounts, modules, users and ad spend than on the vendor.


#### Do 6sense and Demandbase provide contact-level intent?


Both attribute intent to accounts. They can show you contacts at those accounts, but the intent signal itself sits at the company level.


#### Does Demandbase have its own DSP?


Yes. Demandbase runs a B2B DSP and uses bidstream data from it as a core intent source.


#### Does 6sense have a free plan?


Not anymore. 6sense ended its free Sales Intelligence plan in August 2026.


#### What’s the alternative to both 6sense and Demandbase?
